name: packroute-agent
description: Autonomous EU F&B packaging procurement agent with x402 on Algorand

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @packroute/api" "npm run dev -w @packroute/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @packroute/mocks && npm run build -w @packroute/api && npm run build -w @packroute/web
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web "npm run start -w @packroute/api" "npm run start -w @packroute/web"
